page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, it features 4 physical cores and 8 virtual CPUs with dedicated CPU allocation. Hardware specifications include 33 MB of L3 cache alongside support for AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, and FMA instruction set extensions. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of main memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Local storage is bundled directly with the instance, providing 1919 GB of local SSD capacity for direct disk access. The server operates without discrete GPU hardware and maintains a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data reflects mid-tier performance in PassMark CPU testing and Redis SET operations, achieving 6.02 million operations per second. Uncached memory write bandwidth reaches 35.72 GB/sec. Conversely, single-core and multi-core CPU performance in stress-ng, as well as static web serving throughput, fall into lower performance percentiles. The inclusion of high-capacity attached SSD storage alongside dedicated memory offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring local disk throughput without external block volume attachments.

Tradeoffs include limited network throughput and moderate single-thread compute capabilities. The instance is best suited for local database storage, key-value caches like Redis, intermediate data processing, and IO-intensive enterprise workloads.
